{{Top|leg}}
'''Standard Atmosphere''' was a unit of pressure measurement. The pressure of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] ranged from five Standard Atmospheres at the top of the cloud layer to over a million Standard Atmospheres near the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] core, which was equal to 1.28 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] per square centimeter.
